scope: chapters 10-24, all 35 entries; synthesis across the complete 74-entry book

gaps_proposed.reason: PR03 is looking at one's own portion before assigning anyone else's. The son has a famine, a citizen who sent him to the pigs, and misfortune available as explanation and uses none of them.

PR22 is bearing with peevish, complaining or ungrateful behaviour from those one is helping. The man in the ditch is unconscious and expresses nothing. The reviewer's own phrase — cross-boundary generosity — is accurate and is not the definition. Subject matter mistaken for practice, the same substitution declined on Micah 7:1-6 and Luke 9:10-17.

book_summary: One overreach across 74 entries, caught in the first section. Luke supplies the primary anchors for PR25 (14:7-14), PR22 (6:27-36, 17:11-19), PR19 (10:25-37), PR23 (2:1-7, 24:13-35) and PR29 (15:11-32, 23:32-43) — more first-anchors than any other book in the index.
running_tally: Twenty-three additions proposed across all books: ten accepted, one in part, twelve declined.
